sources.title: Teutonic-I 10B — Technical Report
sources.snippet: We report Teutonic-I 10B, a 10-billion-parameter language model produced during a 70-day open competition on Bittensor Teutonic Subnet 3. Rather than synchronously aggregating gradients, independent participants trained challengers to a shared incumbent checkpoint in a sequential "king-of-the-hill" process.
